gizmo.title: Funso la manambala
gizmo.description: Funso loyankhidwa ndi nambala. Yankho ndi nambala yokhazikika kapena fomula yowerengedwa kuchokera ku zosintha, ndipo limavomerezedwa likakhala mkati mwa malire.

configure.title: Funso
configure.description: Zomwe ophunzira afunsidwa. Lembani dzina la chosintha m'mabulaketi opindika, monga {d}, kuti muwonetse mtengo wake.

configure.title: Muyeso
configure.description: Imawonetsedwa ngati zolemba pambali pa malo a yankho, mwachitsanzo km/h.

configure.title: Yankho
configure.description: Nambala yolondola. Siyani chopanda kanthu ngati fomula ikuwerengera yankho.

configure.title: Fomula
configure.description: Imawerengera yankho kuchokera ku zosintha, mwachitsanzo d / (t / 60). Ingagwiritse ntchito + - * / ^, mabulaketi, sqrt() ndi abs(). Imagwiritsidwa ntchito m'malo mwa yankho ikakhazikitsidwa.

configure.title: Zosintha
configure.description: Manambala omwe fomula ndi funso amagwiritsa ntchito. Iliyonse imatenga mtengo pakati pa wotsika ndi wokwera kwambiri, m'masitepe.

advanced.title: Malire olekerera
advanced.description: Kutalika kotani kuchokera ku yankho lenileni komwe kumavomerezedwabe. 0 imatanthauza lenileni, kapena lozunguliridwa ku malo a desimali ali m'munsimu.

advanced.title: Mtundu wa malire olekerera
advanced.description: Weniweni: kuphatikiza kapena kuchotsa malire olekerera. Peresenti: kuphatikiza kapena kuchotsa peresenti imeneyo ya yankho lenileni.

advanced.title: Malo a desimali
advanced.description: Ophunzira afunsidwa kuzungulira ku malo ochuluka awa, ndipo yankho limawonetsedwa lozunguliridwa kotero. Siyani chopanda kanthu kuti pasakhale kuzungulira.

advanced.title: Kuyesa
advanced.description: Kangati wophunzira angayang'ane. 0 imatanthauza mopanda malire.

advanced.title: Manambala atsopano poyesa kulikonse
advanced.description: Bweretsani mitengo yatsopano ya zosintha nthawi iliyonse wophunzira akayesanso. Yankho lawo lam'mbuyo silidzawonetsedwa akabwerera, kokha ngati analondola.

advanced.title: Yopindika
advanced.description: Onetsani funsoli ngati mzere womwe umatseguka ndi kutseka. Kutsegula limodzi kumatseka mafunso ena opindika omwe ali pafupi nalo.

advanced.title: Yambani mopindidwa
advanced.description: Ikakhala yopindika, yambani ngati mzere wotsekedwa womwe umawonetsa funso ndi momwe lilili kokha.

developer.title: Dzina la mayeso
developer.description: Dzina la mayeso logwiritsidwa ntchito pozindikiritsa xAPI m'machitidwe owunika.
